hook.line: The cooperative is being set up, and every meeting ends with someone asking how the thing was decided. Three little frames will answer that for you, whether you are reading the minutes or writing them.

examples.es: Decidimos por consenso, no por votación.
examples.en: We decided by consensus, not by a vote.

examples.es: La junta dio el visto bueno.
examples.en: The board gave the green light.

examples.es: Sin el visto bueno de la junta, no firmamos el contrato.
examples.en: Without the board's approval, we don't sign the contract.

rule:
Formal Spanish says how a decision was reached with *por*, and it has no article: *por consenso*, *por unanimidad*. English says "by consensus" too, so this one is easy.

To say who approved something, Spanish *gives* it, just as English gives the green light:
*dar el visto bueno*: the general green light
*dar su aprobación*: formal approval
*dar su consentimiento*: permission for one specific thing

*Consenso* is the whole group agreeing, with nobody voting against.
smallPrint: These are fixed collocations of formal and administrative writing. *Consenso* is the collective agreement, *aprobación* the approval, *consentimiento* the permission.

readAndPick.es: Decidimos por consenso, no por votación.
options: We reached agreement without a vote.
We settled it with a vote.

readAndPick.es: No hubo consenso, así que votamos.
options: There was agreement, so we didn't vote.
There was no agreement, so we voted.

readAndPick.es: Hubo consenso, así que no votamos.
options: There was agreement, so we didn't vote.
There was no agreement, so we voted.

readAndPick.es: La junta dio el visto bueno.
options: The board gave the green light.

readAndPick.es: La junta no dio el visto bueno.
options: The board didn't give the green light.
The board gave the green light.

readAndPick.es: Sin el visto bueno de la junta, no firmamos el contrato.
options: Without the board's approval, we don't sign the contract.
With the board's approval, we sign the contract.

With the board's approval, we sign the contract.

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *por* or *en* and type the whole sentence: Se aprobó ___ consenso.
yourTurn.why: How a decision was reached takes *por*, with no article.

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *consenso* or *consentimiento* and type the whole sentence: El propietario dio su ___.
yourTurn.why: One person giving permission is *consentimiento*; *consenso* is a whole group agreeing.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: It was decided by consensus.
yourTurn.why: *Se decidió* is the "it was decided" form, then *por consenso*.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: The board gave the green light.
yourTurn.answer: La junta dio el visto bueno.
yourTurn.why: Spanish *gives* approval too: *dar el visto bueno*.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: We didn't give our approval. (We, the group.)
Make it negative: *La junta dio el visto bueno.*
yourTurn.answer: La junta no dio el visto bueno.

yourTurn.why: *Decidimos* is the *we* form of the past; *por consenso* stays as it is.

pitfalls.why: Almost. The way a decision was reached is always *por*.
Almost. The frame has no article, just like English "by consensus".

pitfalls.wrong: La junta hizo el visto bueno.
pitfalls.right: La junta dio el visto bueno.
pitfalls.why: Almost. Approval is something you give, so the verb is *dar*.

personal: Think of a decision your family or your team made together. Say how it was decided, starting with *Decidimos por consenso* or *Lo decidimos por votación*.
